title: Sacks of Salt and Baskets of Fish
summary: Two loads wait in Saltwick: sacks of salt for Wendel Rawlin and baskets of fish for Piers Quarry. Jory Wherry wants them moved before the tide turns.
offer_text: "Two things are late and both are mine to answer for. Wendel Rawlin waits on sacks of salt and Piers Quarry on baskets of fish. Fetch them in any order, before the tide turns."
turn_in_text: "Both in. I shall sleep tonight, which is rare."

objectives.text: Take 2 sacks of salt from the salt pans
Take 3 baskets of fish from the second stack
Hand the sacks of salt to Wendel Rawlin
Hand the baskets of fish to Piers Quarry
Tell Jory Wherry both are in
